event logs to the aggregator

data.notes: Purple: event source. vector/agent-windows.yaml, windows_event_log source, installed by scripts/install-windows-agent.ps1.

Role: ship journald and auditd (audit.log) events
to the aggregator

data.notes: Purple: event source. k8s/vector-shipper.yaml, image timberio/vector 0.61.0-distroless-libc.

devices.label:
AWS logs - OPTIONAL [AU-12]
Role: CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow, S3 access logs
in S3; one SQS queue per type announces objects

Vector Hosts 0.61.0 - always on [AU-3]
Role: aggregator - receives native :6000 and HEC :8088,
VRL normalise, disk buffer, INSERT to ClickHouse

Vector AWS 0.61.0 - OPTIONAL [AU-3]
Role: poll SQS, read S3, VRL normalise, disk buffer
Off by default: aws profile; unit ships disabled

data.notes: Teal: optional ingestion. vector/vector.yaml; container siem-vector.

devices.label:
siem database - 30-day TTL [AU-11]
Role: 7 tables: cloudtrail, guardduty, vpc_flow,
s3_access, windows_events, linux_syslog, k8s_logs

data.notes: Blue: data. clickhouse/ddl/010_aws.sql and 020_hosts.sql. Text index idx_msg_text on windows_events, linux_syslog, k8s_logs; The siem.log_search view over linux, windows, k8s, cloudtrail and guardduty is clickhouse/ddl/050_search.sql. Raw column 7 days except guardduty (30 days); vpc_flow has no raw column.

devices.label:
audit.query_archive - 2-year TTL [AU-9]
Role: audit trail of finished queries, filled by
query_archive_mv from system.query_log

data.notes: Blue: data. clickhouse/ddl/030_audit.sql; system.query_log kept 90 days.

devices.label:
svc_vector - write-only [AU-9]
Role: role siem_ingest, INSERT on siem.* only,
no reads; used by both Vector instances

Read-only accounts [AC-6]
svc_grafana_analyst: SELECT siem.* and log_search
svc_grafana_auditor: SELECT siem.* and audit.*

data.notes: Blue: access control. Roles siem_analyst and siem_auditor; settings profile siem_reader (readonly=2). Queries from these shared accounts (one per Grafana datasource) land in audit.query_archive.
Grey: not deployed. Disabled configuration only.

devices.label:
Grafana 13.3.0 - :3000 [AU-5, AU-6]
Role: the only UI - dashboards, Log Search, SQL explore,
7 AU-5 ingestion-silence alerts; native local login

data.notes: Amber: application. grafana/grafana image 13.3.0 (Open Source edition), ClickHouse plugin 4.23.4. grafana/provisioning: two ClickHouse datasources over native :9000; Log Search dashboard queries siem.log_search.

devices.label:
Analysts and auditors
Role: sign in to Grafana :3000 with its
local account; no SSO or MFA

data.notes: Purple: people. No IdP, SSO or MFA is deployed (docs/local-auth.md).
